def recover_scores(n, k, l, r, sall, sk):
    # Calculate the average score for the top k students
    avg_top_k = sk // k
    # Calculate the average score for the rest of the students
    avg_rest = (sall - sk) // (n - k)
    
    # Initialize the scores list with the average score for the rest of the students
    scores = [avg_rest] * (n - k)
    
    # Distribute the remaining points to the top k students
    remaining_points = sk - avg_top_k * k
    for i in range(remaining_points):
        scores[i] += 1
    
    # Ensure the top k students have the correct score
    scores[:k] = [avg_top_k] * k
    
    return scores
